title: 第5章 任务专属装备第6章 调虎离山
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
接取了剧情任务的李凯南，本打算现在就去将狼人解决掉。
超凡邪恶生物？
切，还不是肉体凡胎。
此前狼人都被李凯南逼着扯断胳膊狼狈逃命，他怕个毛线啊！
但布兰妮外婆却是拦住了他，取出了布兰妮带过来的蛋糕、红酒，然后请李凯南不要着急，可以先吃午饭休息一下。
此前狼人被李凯南重伤，此时一定是正躲在森林的某处地方舔舐伤口呢。
凭借李凯南的武力消灭它并不难，可是在偌大的森林之中想要找到狼人的踪迹，却并非是什么容易的事情！
布兰妮的外婆之前就写信给自己的朋友老猎人向他求助，他今天下午就能赶到。
猎人最擅长的事情，就是追击、猎杀野兽了！
只要等到他赶来会合，和李凯南一起联手，就算是这只狼人再狡猾也没用……
李凯南接受了这个建议，也觉得自己可以准备更加充分一些。
吃过午饭之后，他索要了一块磨刀石，开始给自己腰间的那柄骑士剑开锋。
这里又没有砂带机进行开锋，只能先这样用了。
累是累了点，但他现在身体素质极其恐怖，完全可以“大力出奇迹”！
可惜李凯南不知道自己要穿越，否则他也不带这把没开锋的“样子货”了。
他家里的武器库收藏中，可还藏着好几把真正开锋的剑呢……
……
李凯南一直等到了下午，布兰妮外婆的老猎人朋友终于赶到了。
老猎人身形高大，看上去五六十岁的模样，面容有些沧桑。
不过背负长弓，腰插猎刀，看上去也非常有气势！

当老猎人熟练地走进小院之中，却只看到坐在院子里低着头专心打磨配剑的李凯南。
这陌生的身影让老猎人猛地一惊，甚至让他以为自己还是来晚了……
想到了某种残酷的可能，老猎人呼吸一滞，眼眸泛红的同时原本沧桑面相也变得异常凶悍了起来！
老猎人身上那股能撕裂猎物的狠劲凶悍，以及常年厮杀的血腥凶气，让李凯南猛地抬头。
刻在骨子里对战斗的渴望，让此时的李凯南不仅没有因为老猎人的这股凶悍气势所震慑，眼神反而变得炙热起来。
他无意识摩挲了两下手中的配剑，剑刃上带着漂亮羽毛纹路的华丽骑士剑微微晃动，新磨的刃口泛着细碎凛冽的冷辉……
下一刻，一股强横到不讲道理的恐怖威压从李凯南的身上散发出来！
感受着来自李凯南身上那宛若神灵一般的强横气势，老猎人身体都不由微微颤抖起来。
可即便如此，老猎人也没有选择逃离，而是咬着牙伸出颤抖的手想要拔出腰间的猎刀。
在这个山林野外充斥着各种超凡种族、邪恶生物的世界中，老猎人能够成为老猎人，自身战力、意志、心性都绝非一般存在……
而眼看着两人就要动起手来，布兰妮外婆终于从木屋中走了出来。
在看到安然无恙的布兰妮外婆时，刚刚还能因为心中悲愤而生出拼死报仇念头的老猎人顿时气势一泄。
老猎人沧桑的脸上露出惊喜之色，无比庆幸地道：
“波娜，你和布兰妮没事啊！”
布兰妮外婆意识到两人似乎是产生了一些误会，连忙介绍两人认识。
这位名为巴伦的老猎人了解了情况之后脸色涨红，更是变得手足无措起来。
content_en:
Li Kainan, who accepted the plot mission, originally planned to kill the werewolf now.
Extraordinary evil creature?
Yep, it’s not a mortal body yet.
Previously, the werewolves were forced by Li Kainan to tear off their arms and run for their lives in embarrassment. He was so scared!
But Grandma Britney stopped him, took out the cake and red wine that Britney had brought, and then asked Li Kainan not to be anxious and to have lunch and rest first.
The werewolf was seriously injured by Li Kainan before, and he must be hiding somewhere in the forest licking his wounds at this time.
It is not difficult to eliminate it with Li Kainan's force, but it is not easy to find traces of the werewolf in the huge forest!
Britney's grandmother had written to her friend Old Hunter to ask for help, and he would be able to arrive this afternoon.
What hunters are best at is chasing and killing wild animals!
As long as he arrives and joins forces with Li Kainan, it will be useless no matter how cunning the werewolf is...
Li Kainan accepted this suggestion and felt that he could be more prepared.
After lunch, he asked for a whetstone and began to sharpen the knight's sword at his waist.
There is no belt sander here for cutting, so we can only use it like this first.
He is a little tired, but his current physical condition is extremely terrifying and he can definitely "do miracles with great force"!
It's a pity that Li Kainan didn't know that he was going to travel through time, otherwise he wouldn't have brought this "looking weapon" without an edge.
There are still several truly sharp swords hidden in his family's arsenal collection...
…
Li Kainan waited until the afternoon, when Grandma Britney's old hunter friend finally arrived.
The old hunter was tall, looked to be in his fifties or sixties, and his face looked a little weathered.
But with a long bow on his back and a hunting knife on his waist, he looks very imposing!
When the old hunter skillfully walked into the small courtyard, he only saw Li Kainan sitting in the courtyard with his head lowered and concentrating on polishing his sword.
This strange figure startled the old hunter, and even made him think that he was still late...
Thinking of some kind of cruel possibility, the old hunter's breath froze, his eyes turned red, and his old face became extremely fierce!
The old hunter's fierceness and ferocity that could tear apart his prey, as well as the bloody ferocity of years of fighting, made Li Kainan look up sharply.
With the desire for battle engraved in his bones, Li Kainan was not only not intimidated by the ferocious momentum of the old hunter, but his eyes became hot instead.
He unconsciously touched the sword in his hand twice. The gorgeous knight's sword with beautiful feather patterns on the blade shook slightly, and the newly sharpened edge glowed with a fine and cold light...
The next moment, a terrifying pressure that was so tyrannical and unreasonable radiated from Li Kainan's body!
Feeling the god-like powerful aura coming from Li Kainan, the old hunter's body couldn't help but tremble slightly.
But even so, the old hunter did not choose to escape. Instead, he gritted his teeth and stretched out his trembling hands to pull out the hunting knife from his waist.
In this world filled with all kinds of extraordinary races and evil creatures in the mountains and wilds, an old hunter can become an old hunter, and his own fighting power, will, and character are by no means ordinary...
Seeing that the two were about to start a fight, Grandma Britney finally walked out of the wooden house.
When he saw Grandma Britney safe and sound, the old hunter, who had just been thinking of desperate revenge because of the grief and anger in his heart, suddenly lost his momentum.
The old hunter's vicissitudes of life showed a look of surprise, and he said with great joy:
"Bona, you and Britney are okay!"
Grandma Britney realized that there seemed to be some misunderstandings between the two, and quickly introduced them to each other.
After understanding the situation, the old hunter named Barron's face turned red and he became even more at a loss.
